iptables_save.data:
# A router: eth0 is the uplink (198.51.100.7), eth1 the local network (192.168.1.0/24).
# It sends three ports to hosts behind it, hides the local network, and redirects the
# web traffic of the local network to a proxy on the router.
# Written after the rules of such a host, not captured: the addresses are examples.
*nat
:PREROUTING ACCEPT [0:0]
:INPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
:POSTROUTING ACCEPT [0:0]
-A PREROUTING -i eth0 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 8443 -j DNAT --to-destination 192.168.1.50:443
-A PREROUTING -s 203.0.113.0/24 -i eth0 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 2222 -j DNAT --to-destination 192.168.1.10:22
-A PREROUTING -i eth0 -p udp -m udp --dport 51820 -j DNAT --to-destination 192.168.1.20:51820
-A PREROUTING -i eth1 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 80 -j REDIRECT --to-ports 3128
-A POSTROUTING -s 192.168.1.0/24 -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE
COMMIT
*filter
:INPUT DROP [0:0]
:FORWARD DROP [0:0]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
-A INPUT -i lo -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -m conntrack --ctstate INVALID -j DROP
-A INPUT -p icmp -m icmp --icmp-type 8 -m limit --limit 5/sec -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -i eth1 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 22 -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -i eth1 -p udp -m udp --dport 53 -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -i eth1 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 53 -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -i eth1 -p udp -m udp --sport 68 --dport 67 -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -i eth1 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 3128 -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -m conntrack --ctstate INVALID -j DROP
-A FORWARD -i eth1 -o eth0 -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -d 192.168.1.50/32 -i eth0 -o eth1 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -d 192.168.1.10/32 -i eth0 -o eth1 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 22 -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -d 192.168.1.20/32 -i eth0 -o eth1 -p udp -m udp --dport 51820 -j ACCEPT
COMMIT
